name: irrigation-water-management
description: 灌区配水管理桌面应用
author: Irrigation Management Station

scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-packager . "灌区配水管理系统" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --ignore="node_modules/electron-builder" --ignore="node_modules/7zip-bin"
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && set NODE_ENV=development&& electron ."
scripts.electron:build: vite build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-packager . "灌区配水管理系统" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite
